args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change updates `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and the test expectations (e.g., 2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).

CI: passed (ci-0001)

2. **Fixed the code**: Created branch `fix/bankers-rounding` from `main` and updated `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`, matching the docstring and test expectations (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
